raffle.title: Prize draws
raffle.heroTitle: All draw, dem settle am on-chain.
raffle.heroBody: DeHub prize draw dem di share DeHub token, hardware and collectible fo people weh dem di use the platform already. You di get entry when you take part, dem di publish the entry list before the draw, and na transaction weh everybody fit read di pick the winner.
raffle.findLiveDraw: Find the live draw fo your feed
raffle.noPurchase: No money dey need. Every draw get one free way to enter, and if dem give ticket, dat one no be di only way to enter.
raffle.anatomyPrizeBody: Dem tok am wen di draw open. No change after dat.
raffle.anatomyRoutesBody: List am well well, with di weight wey each one carry.
raffle.anatomyClosingBody: One fixed time, no be "when we go do am".
raffle.anatomySnapshotBody: Dem di publish am before dem run the draw.
raffle.anatomyRandomnessBody: Dem draw am on-chain, fo inside transaction weh you fit open.
raffle.anatomyClaimBody: 14 days from the result wey dem publish.
raffle.howBody: Four step, the same order, every time. The part weh e di decide who win di happen fo open.
raffle.step1Body: Every draw open wit im prize, im closing time and di exact ways to get entry, post for di app and pin for di feed.
raffle.step2Body: Entries dem dey give you for doing wetin you dey do already for DeHub. The announcement go show which action dey count for that draw and how many entries each one worth.
raffle.step3Body: When time finish, dem go snap the list of people wey enter, and dem go pick the winning number from something wey dey for inside the computer, not from paper.
raffle.step4Body: The snapshot, the transaction and the winning entry di comot together, so anybody fit check the result again instead fo just believe we.
raffle.entriesTitle: Entry dem dey earn, dem no dey buy
raffle.entriesBody: Draws dem dey favour pipo wey dey use DeHub. Every announcement dey mention di routes wey dey count for am. Dis na dem wey draws dey usually build from.
raffle.postBody: Your own post dem, video dem and comment dem di count fo draw weh dem name dem.
raffle.stakeBody: One open staking position dey give you entries for the draws wey dey weigh am.
raffle.arcadeBody: Arcade game dem and leaderboard position dem di feed draw weh dem build around game.
raffle.stagesBody: Come for live audio stages dey count, whether you talk or you listen.
raffle.ticketBody: Some draw dem di also sell ticket weh you di pay with DeHub token. If dem do am, dem di publish the price and how many one wallet fit buy before.
raffle.collectibleBody: Some NFT collections get standing entries for draws wey dem name dem.
raffle.fairnessBody: Raffle dey worth enter only if di person wey organize am no fit quietly pick who go win. Three tins make dat one true for here.
raffle.fair1Body: Di list wey dem dey use for entry dem go snapshot am for di time wey dem talk say e go close, den dem go publish am before dem start di draw. Nothing fit enter am after dat, even us no fit add anything.
raffle.fair2Title: Randomness di come from the chain
raffle.fair2Body: Di winning index dey come from on-chain, so di number wey dey decide di draw dey inside public transaction, no be inside internal tool.
raffle.fair3Body: Snapshot, transaction hash and winning entry, dem di publish all together. If you run the calculation again from public data, you go reach the same winner.
raffle.neverPayTitle: DeHub no go ever ask you fo pay before you collect prize
raffle.neverPayBody: Winners dem go show for di app and for di public result post. Nobody from DeHub go call you for money, seed phrase, private key or wallet signature to give you prize. Any message wey do dat na fake. Report am and delete am.
raffle.faqBody: Dem wey dem dey ask us pass pass about draws, entries and prizes.
raffle.faq1Q: I must buy something before I fit enter DeHub prize draw?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: No. Every draw get at least one free way to enter, wey you fit get by taking part on DeHub. Some draws dey sell ticket wey you go pay with DeHub tokens, but ticket no be the only way to enter.
raffle.faq2Q: How I go know say dem no fix the draw?
raffle.faq2A: Di entry list dem snapshotted and publish am before di draw run, and di winning index dem draw am from an on-chain source of randomness. Di snapshot, di transaction and di winning entry dem publish dem together so di result fit recompute by anybody.
raffle.faq3A: Winners go see dem for inside di app and dem go mention dem for di result post. No email go come ask you for money, seed phrase or wallet signature. DeHub no go ever ask for any of dat to give you your prize.
raffle.faq4Q: How long I get to claim?
raffle.faq4A: Fourteen days from when the result come out. Token prizes go straight to the winner's DeHub wallet on Base. Physical prizes, we arrange am direct with the team, and we go cover shipping if we fit legally ship.
raffle.faq5A: Any person wey get DeHub account, wey don pass 18 years, and wey dey live for place where the draw no against the law. DeHub workers, contractors and their family no fit claim, and draws wey local law no allow, dem no go stand.
raffle.faq6A: No time wey we fix. Draws dey follow launches, big achievements and partner campaigns, and dem go announce each one for the app when e start.
raffle.ctaBody: Anything wey dey happen now, dem go announce am for your feed. Put on your notifications so the next one no go pass you.
raffle.legal: Prize draws na promotion and open for DeHub account holders wey don pass 18 years, dem no go stand if local law no allow am. DeHub workers, contractors and their family no fit claim. Prizes no fit change to money unless dem talk am, and each draw announcement get all the terms.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.intro: DeHub get five way enta, no one of dem need you buy wallet: Google, Apple, code wey dey send for your email, code wey dey send for your SMS, or wallet wey you connect already. Everyting except wallet way create non-custodial wallet for you for background - you hold key, DeHub pay gas so you fit post, tip and collect without buy native token.

steps.1: Go fo dehub.io — home feed na di front page, so yu fit look around before yu sign in.
steps.2: Klik 'Sign In'. Yu go see Google na Apple, filds for emai adres or fon nomber, na 'Connect Wallet' for existin wan.
steps.3: Wen yu use Google or Apple, komplait provider's flow. Wen yu use email or SMS, enta kod wey arrive.
steps.4: Wallet bi create an secure fo yin on first sign-in. Connectin yin own wallet bi mean one signat to prove address.
steps.5: Choose username. Na wetin pipo go see, and e still be yu profile link dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Yu dey enter. Explore feed, set up profail, naa start post.

tips.1: Pipo weh sign in wit social, email or SMS no di ever pay gas — DeHub di pay am. Wallet weh dem connect di pay dia own ETH or BNB.
tips.2: Yu dey come back to yor ol' DeHub account? Sign in wit yor email or phone number wey dey use before, migration go find am for yor.
tips.3: Yu fit keep several account for one device an' switch between dem for Settings → Profile.

home-feed.title: Hom Feed

tips.1: Grid view bi gud for browse image quick.
tips.2: Tab 'Home' dey show all tins wey dey mixed together.
tips.3: Live tab shows currently active live streams.

home-feed.intro: Feed ya dey where yu see post from pipo wey yu dey follow an trendin kontent. E support multiple kontent-type tab an sorting opshon.

steps.1: Go near /app – dis be your home feed.
steps.2: Yu go select tab wey you want, na so you go see content wey dey inside am.
steps.3: Swip lef/right ya, si tabz ya dey show ya more opshonz for mobail.
steps.4: Wen yu wok wit feed, yu go fit chenj sorting usin filter/sort button wey dey top-right of feed.
steps.5: Pull am down fo refresh di feed fo phone.
steps.6: Scroll go down make more post load by e sef (infinite scroll).
steps.7: Kam gud, yu fit chenj layout wey yu dey use, yu fit chenj to Grid or Feed view paa.

creating-posts.title: Creating Posts

tips.1: Posts support markdown-style formatting.
tips.2: Yuu go post again by klick am repost icon for post na select 'Quote'.
tips.3: Category dem (hashtag) di show fo 'Talk of the Town' leaderboard.

creating-posts.intro: Post, share pikin, voice notis, GIFs, an' more. Use #hashtag, cashtag, an' mention to increase reach.

steps.1: Klik post buton wey dey sidebar (desktop) or + buton (mobile).
steps.2: Na me dey wait for wetin you go write.
steps.3: Yu go click icon of media na select file.
steps.4: Tiketa voice note, klick microphone icon.
steps.5: Kam giff, klick GIF icon na search for one.
steps.6: I no understand wetin you dey talk.
steps.7: $cashtags no dey make sense for me.
steps.8: Use @mention fo tag oda user dem (like @username).
steps.9: Klik 'Post' to publish. Ya post dey appear for feed immediately.

explore-search.intro: Find new content and user dem through explore page and search weh strong well.
explore-search.title: Explore & Search

steps.1: Go find am for sidebar, navigate to /app/explore.
steps.2: Use di search bar for top go search for pipo, post, or tin wey you dey find.
steps.3: Yooki yooki, filter result bi tab: All, Pipo, Pọt, Piks, Vidiyo, Musik, Liva.
steps.4: Browse trendin topik an categories for explore paji.
steps.5: Klik insis on topik wey dey trend to see all post wey relate.
steps.6: Klik paa wuman bi search result to visit dia profail.

tips.1: Yanga search support pesin wey dey use username, wallet address, and keyword for search.
tips.2: Trending topik update bas on recent post wey dey happen.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Yout profail showkam yout póst, folozer, foloing, an wallet inforamayshun.

steps.1: Klik yor poto ya yu or 'Profile' for view yu profile.
steps.2: Click 'Edit Profile' fo change yu display name, bio and avatar.
steps.3: Uploa picha ya profail yu by klikin on yu avata in edit moda.
steps.4: Yu go check ya follower and followin count for ya profail page.
steps.5: Browse yor own post, media, and like content via di profile tab.
steps.6: Kopi wallet address yu, klick icon wey dey beside am.
steps.7: Go visit pipo profile by click dia username or dia poto anywhere for platform.

tips.1: Yu be unique, na yu name dey show for yu profile URL (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Yu go fit control who go see ya follower count.

messages.title: Message dem
messages.intro: Senda mesaji direkt to oda pesin we dey for platform.

steps.1: Klik 'Messages' for inbox open.
steps.2: Klik di kompos button to start new konversayshun.
steps.3: Sori, no be say you go find user by username, but you fit search am.
steps.4: Wen yu type yor mesaji, yu press send.
steps.5: Yüü yüü yin na ya conversation history ya me ya.
steps.6: Klik insait konversayshun na kontiniu chatti.

tips.1: Yu go receive notis wen pesin send yu message.
tips.2: Kreator dem fit lock mesaji behind tip requirement.

ai-assistant.title: AI Asista
ai-assistant.intro: Chop chat wit' DeHub's AI assistant, e dey help yu wit' tins, give yu info, and even help yu wit' kreativ task.

steps.1: Klik 'Assistant' insaidbar to open chat bilong AI.
steps.2: Wen yu wan ask somtin, ask me.
steps.3: Ai go help yu wit kripto infor, platform question, na general knowlegde.
steps.4: Kam gud? Kip start new konversayshun by klik new chat buton.
steps.5: Yu go see yim konversayshun history for sidebar of assistant paje.
steps.6: Yu go attach images for me translate?

tips.1: Matai ai yong remember kontext for konversayshun.
tips.2: Yu go ask AI fit for DeHub feature, crypto term, or general question.
tips.3: Kam conversation bi dey save an save, an dem dey fit dey access anytime.

notifications.title: Notifikayshuns
notifications.intro: Yap stay update wit like, komment, tip, follow, anoda aktiviti on yu kontri.

steps.1: Klik bell icon or 'Notifications' wey dey sidebar.
steps.2: Yu go see all notis wey dey for chronological list.
steps.3: Klik insis notification na go navigate to content wey relate.
steps.4: Notis dey include: new folowers, post vot, komment, tipe, and mention.
steps.5: Unred notifications dey shine — dem mark as red wen dey view.

tips.1: Notifayshun bada show kount of unread notifayshun.
tips.2: Tip notification show how many token yu receive.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.intro: Yu go see ya DeHub tok balance for many chain, check staking deposit, na manage ya asset.

steps.1: Klik 'Wallet' for sidemenu, open wallet paja.
steps.2: Yu go see yam balance for all chain wey support am.
steps.3: See breakdown fit for chain: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, and more.
steps.4: Chek yor stakin deposit an reward.
steps.5: Klik 'Refresh Scan' fit for update yu balance fit for on-chain data.
steps.6: Kopi wallet yu adresa, na emi go dey receive tokens from odas.

tips.1: Balans update automatic, but yu fit force refresh anytime.
tips.2: D wallet show both liquid (available) and stake balance.

staking.title: Stakin
staking.intro: Stakim DeHub tokens ya, earn reward na increase ya powa go vot.

steps.1: Go find 'Staking' page forum sidebar.
steps.2: Wen yu wok wit stake, enter di numba of tokens yu wok wit.
steps.3: M chapa chain yu wok selekt?
steps.4: Yu confirm transaksion for wallet yu dey use (wallets outside) or e go auto-execute (login wey you dey use social media).
steps.5: See yo stake amount and any pending reward.
steps.6: Kam gud, enta amount na confirm transaksion.

tips.1: Stakin ina increase vot weight in gavament propos.
tips.2: Social-login user no need gas fo stake — gasless.
tips.3: Yu fit stake for multiple chain simultaneously.

leaderboard.intro: See who top! Leaderboard rank user by balance, daily spend, and trending topic.
leaderboard.title: Ledarboad

steps.1: Go find am 'Leaderboard' paa from sidebar.
steps.2: Switch between tab: Balance, Daily Spent, and Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Balance tab ranks users by their total token holdings.
steps.4: Daily Spent tab show who dey dey active for tipping for last 24 hours.
steps.5: Talk of di Town show am di most-discussed topic/categories.
steps.6: Click any user fo visit profile.
steps.7: Leaderboard update pia update periodically throughout da day.

tips.1: Daily rankings reset every 24 hours.
tips.2: Talk of the Town track single-word category from hashtag.

command-centre.title: Komand Senta
command-centre.intro: Dashboard ya yambo show key metriks na aktivity ya platfoim ya yu na one glans.

steps.1: Klik 'Command Centre' insid e sidebar.
steps.2: Yu go see yim profail summary, including post kaount, folowers, and engajment.
steps.3: See yo recent activity and trending topic.
steps.4: Wok dis quick link fo find tins wey you dey look for.

tips.1: Command Sentra giv yim bird-eye view of yim DeHub presence.

governance.title: Governs

tips.1: Yu voting powa dey depend on di number of tokens yu stake.
tips.2: Badge holders may get additional vote weight.
tips.3: Proposals go through stages: Active → Passed/Rejected.

governance.intro: Partisipate for platform govnans by create proposal and vot on komuniti decision.

steps.1: Go near "Goverment" from sidebar.
steps.2: Bros, browse active proposals wey community dey submit.
steps.3: Klik insis proposal na redi am full description na discussion.
steps.4: Vot blong propozishon usim buton up/down — vot yua wok bas on how mani DeHub tokn yua stak.
steps.5: Wetin you go do be wey wey, leave comments on proposals so we can talk about dem wit community.
steps.6: Wen yu wok wan submit yor own propoz, yu go klick di 'Kree8 Propoz' buton.

bookmarks.title: Bookmark dem
bookmarks.intro: Save post fo yor bookmark fo easy access later.

steps.1: Klik di bookmark icon for save post.
steps.2: Go find "Bookmarks" for side bar, see all save post.
steps.3: Klik an na bookmark post yu wok view am full.
steps.4: Kam deya, kip klick di bookmark icon anod remove di bookmark.

tips.1: Bukmark dey private — only you sabi wetin you save.
tips.2: No limit to how many post you fit book mark.

settings.title: Setting dem

steps.1: Klik 'Settings' insida sidebar.
steps.2: M chenge display laengen from selektan laengen.
steps.3: Adjust priwansi: Kontrolla who dey see your folo count na who you dey folo.
steps.4: Mi go set mi post visibility preference to Public.
steps.5: Manage notification preferences.

tips.1: DeHub support multiple langwaj, de whole interface dey translate.
tips.2: Privacy settings apply immediately.

settings.intro: Yook customize yor DeHub experience wit language, privacy, na display preference.

reactions-and-safety.title: Reactions, Muting & Mature Content
reactions-and-safety.intro: Dem nine reaksishon dey for behin like button, na set of kontrols wey dey help yu decide wetin yu go see and who go fit reach yu.

steps.1: Hold di thumbs-up fo any post fo open di reaction tray: like, love, respect, hot, lol, sad, cry, dislike and poo.
steps.2: Di seven pipo we dey like, dem count towards di post like total; dislike and poo count against am.
steps.3: Yu reaction weight di follow yu staking badge, so reaction fo person weh get badge di move di count pass one vote.
steps.4: Tap di X fo post header fo mute di person weh write am — e go comot fo yu feed one time.
steps.5: Kreator dem mark dia own post wey dey mature while dem dey kompose am; post wey dem mark dis way no go appear for public home feed.
steps.6: Na ya, turn on "Show mature content" for Settings.

tips.1: Post wey dey mature, still dey visible for creator account and to pipo wey dey follow am.
tips.2: Blak blokin from pipo profile go beyond mute, na even block pesin from send yim messaji.
tips.3: Di reaksiyon tray dey show who reakt and wetin dem reakt wit, so yu no dey see just number, yu dey see di room.

stages.title: Stages (Live Audio Rooms)
stages.intro: Stages bi audio room wey dey build inside DeHub. Host open room, bring speaker up, an anyone fit join listen from Stages paje or shared link.

steps.1: Open 'Stages' fo sidebar fo see wetin dey live now and wetin dem don plan.
steps.2: Tap live stage join listener, or set reminder on schedule one, get told wen e start.
steps.3: Start yu own fo di same page — yu fit go live straight from browser, no OBS or stream key.
steps.4: Mi go bring speaker-dem on stage, mute dem or remove dem, share screen, na soundboard go drive am.
steps.5: Pipo dey send live reactions and dey chat for room, but dem no dey come on stage.
steps.6: E ben stage record, na recording dey play back afta from card am dey sit.

tips.1: Live subtitle di write wetin every speaker talk and translate am fo any language weh yu di read.
tips.2: Live dubbing go speak am for di room, make am de host own voice, dem dey bill am by minute for DeHub tokens.
tips.3: Host dem fit put radio station fo air or play dia own music clip between di tok dem.
tips.4: Mini-player dey keep room go, while yu browse rest of app.

communities.title: Communities & Events
communities.intro: Kampani dem dey run by memba, wit dia own feed, memba, na aktivity. Evens add taim-bound progreming on top of dem.

steps.1: Kam gud, go open 'Communities' for sidbarr na browse public ones.
steps.2: Kam join one tap. Nya activity dey show as unread badge for navigation.
steps.3: Post, diskut, run poll na tip insid komuniti own feed.
steps.4: Kampanyun dem dey moderate dia own kampani na dem fit grant admin right to odas.
steps.5: Open 'Event' for schedule progam wey you fit follow along wit live, one paja per event.

tips.1: Kam chat kam support @mention na @here, so post fit reach room.
tips.2: Invite link yɛ na yɛ bɛ kɛ community.

arcade.intro: Five game di run inside DeHub fo browser tab — notin fo install, notin fo buy.
arcade.title: Arcade

steps.1: Open 'Arcade' fo sidebar.
steps.2: Mi go chos King's Gambit.
steps.3: Play fo di tab. King's Gambit and Street Slayer get leaderboard.
steps.4: Chartopia also run for VR headset for WebXR.

tips.1: Two of dem hide inside di appearance theme dem — put di app fo War fo Claude of Duty, or Jungle fo Jungle Trail.
tips.2: Eva game get share card, so link to one dey unfurl wel wel wey yu post am.

bounties-stores.title: Bounties & Stores
bounties-stores.intro: Yu go fit turn platform ya into income for yu: post or claim bounty, or open shop na sell to pipo wey dey follow yu.

steps.1: Buka 'Bounties' na browse open wok, filter by kategory or kurensi.
steps.2: Klaaim wan, go do am, na reward go dey wait am - anybodi fit be hunter, no need apply.
steps.3: Mun ya post ya bounti ya wona, na brief na reward ya DeHub token or USDC. Ya go into escrow moment ya post am.
steps.4: Kam paa 'Stores' set up stôr ai paa paja, wia e dey wok, na branding na listings.
steps.5: Product dey dey price an settle for DeHub tokens for wallet wey dey build-in, witout external checkout.

tips.1: Bounties dey organize for Social Media, Clipping na Contracts.
tips.2: Dispute flow settle di disagreement wey dey come from delivery, so escrow always resolve fairly.
tips.3: Kreator dem use bounties to grow community - shares, klips an reaksyon dey all valid task.

creator-studio.title: Creator Studio & Editor
creator-studio.intro: Kreator Studio yonge images, video, musik, voice na 3D model from prompt, na hand dem to edito - including a full multi-track video edito wey run for browser.

steps.1: Mi go open Creator Studio, na me go dey create somtin new. Me want make video, but no be just any video, me want make video wey go dey interesting, wey go dey capture di attention of pipo. Me want make video wey go dey show di beauty of Cameroon, di culture, di people, di food, di music, di dance, di everything! Me want make video wey go dey make pipo feel like dem dey Cameroon, like dem dey feel di vibe, di energy, di passion of di people.
steps.2: Server go tell you price before e do job, so you know wetin you go pay before you pay am.
steps.3: Renders dey continue for one shared queue while yu dey browse app.
steps.4: Arrange wetin e give yu fo editor weh e be like Canva, or open video editor fo real timeline wit cutting, layering and export.
steps.5: I no understand wetin you dey talk.

tips.1: Librai bilong free stok aset libri sit long side Studio, na emi dey for eni tins yu no wan genereit.
tips.2: Na DeHub tokens from yu wallet di pay fo generation — yu sign one transfer fo every job, and we go show yu di price before yu pay.
tips.3: Pipo weh di use am plenti fit take Ultra, Team or Scale plan, weh e di send token allowance every month straight fo dia wallet.

buying-dhb.intro: Buy DeHub tokens straight inside di app wit di swap weh dey inside.
buying-dhb.title: Buying Tokens

steps.1: Go sidon sideway, find "Buy" paja, click am.
steps.2: Swap tokn yu wok want.
steps.3: Wen yu wok, enta di amount yu wan spend or di numba of tokens yu wan get.
steps.4: Na exchange rate na 1 USD dey sell for 570 CFA. Estimated output go be 1,140,000 CFA.
steps.5: Klik settings gear ikon to adjust slippage tolerance (defaut na 1%).
steps.6: Kam gud, transaction swap don confirm.
steps.7: DeHub tokens go dey for ya wallet wen transaction complete.

tips.1: Slippaji ya up na, e dey increase chance of execute, but possibility of price bad dey high.
tips.2: Biko, check exchange rate beforu yu confirm.
tips.3: Yu fit set custom slippage for settings panel.

bridge.title: Bridge

tips.1: Bridge fees vary by chain pair.
tips.2: For now, na hand dem di use for pay bridge money.
tips.3: Biko, dey always check chain of destination before confirm.

bridge.intro: Yu go move yor DeHub tokens wey dey different blockchain tok use cross-chain bridj.

steps.1: Go find Bridge page from sidebar.
steps.2: Select di source chain (place weh yu tokens dey now).
steps.3: Chain 1: Cameroon
steps.4: Na 5 token.
steps.5: Check di bridge fee and di time weh we think say e go reach.
steps.6: Kam konfirm bridge transaction.
steps.7: Di team go send di tokens for di destination chain, plenti time inside 1-5 work day.

music-tv.title: Music & TV
music-tv.intro: Yen enjoy media kontent direkti for DeHub — stream musik and watch laif TV chanels.

steps.1: Go find 'Music' for sidebar, browse and play music post.
steps.2: Go near TV, see live TV channels.
steps.3: Browse chanel by kat or kontri.
steps.4: Klik an wan channel to start watch.
steps.5: Yu use player kontrollz adjust volume na playback.
steps.6: Report channel dem weh no di work wit di report button.

tips.1: TV chanels dey get veri-dem for reliabiliti.
tips.2: Muzik post dey fit pley wile yu dey browse anoda kontent.

post-info.title: Post Info & Fractions
post-info.intro: Post wey dey minted na NFT wey dey split into 1,000 pieces. Post Info page show data wey dey on-chain, stat wey dey show how people dey engage, how ownership dey break down, and make you fit trade pieces of any post — on post wey no dey minted, e go offer you to mint instead.

steps.1: Tap am 'ⓘ' icon for post, open Post Info paja.
steps.2: Yu go see Token ID (unique on-chain identifier) an transaction hash — click hash to view am for block explorer.
steps.3: Bia, statis bileng na pipo don dey engage, na im dey show total laik, dislike, view, koment, na tipe dem don receive.
steps.4: Holders section di show progress bar fo how many of di 1,000 fraction dem di creator still get, and list fo all di pipo weh get fraction, wit dia balance and percentage.
steps.5: If di post na pay-per-view (PPV), yu go see price, kuri, and how many pipo don buy access.
steps.6: Pipo wey dey own post, dem fit change visibility (Public, Unlisted, or Private) and edit titl/describ straight from dis page.

tips.1: A newly minted post start wit di creator hold all 1,000 fractions (100% ownership).
tips.2: Transaksion hash link to BaseScan or BscScan depend on chain.
tips.3: Post wey no dey list, no go dey appear for feeds but still dey accessible via direct link.

trading-fractions.title: Trading Fractions
trading-fractions.intro: Fraishon taim frai, bai listin, mek ofa, listin ya own — dey happun for de web ap at dehub.io, for each pos on Post Info paj.

steps.1: Open dehub.io fo browser and sign in wit di same account.
steps.2: Open post info paja na switch to marketplace tab.
steps.3: Look di listing dem, make offer fo yu own price, or list fraction dem weh yu get.
steps.4: Wen trade kom complete, change go show for yin Fractions tab dey here for mobile.

tips.1: Yu dey hold pawa of dat on-chain NFT.
tips.2: Kam check post holder wey dey online market before buy am.
tips.3: Manga creator, bi sell pawa fraishon, make fan dey own pawa wey dey content.

minting-posts.title: Minting Posts (Creating NFTs)
minting-posts.intro: Minting na optional. Post publish of-chain, taim yu send am - no wallet, no sign, no gas - na yu go mint am as NFT, wen yu dey compose am or later from post itself.

steps.1: Klik post buton wey dey sidebar (desktop) or + buton (mobile).
steps.2: Write yu text, put media (picture, video, audio), and add category dem.
steps.3: Leave 'Mint post' off fo publish off-chain, or on am fo mint as yu di publish.
steps.4: Publishing no wait am for chain: post go publish for feed, whether you like am or no.
steps.5: Tin mint later, opn post 'ⓘ' info paja na use Mint aktion dey.
steps.6: Wen mint, post get Token ID na transaction hash yu fit verify on-chain, na yu hold all 1,000 fraishun of am.

tips.1: Pipo weh sign in wit social, email or SMS no di pay any gas — DeHub di pay di minting fee dem.
tips.2: Pipo weh di use external wallet need ETH fo Base or BNB fo BNB Chain fo gas.
tips.3: Minting na wetin make post dey fit trade and dey bring royalty. Post wey no dey mint still go get tips and views.
tips.4: Record ya on-chain permanent, even if post ya dey delete from feed.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Glossari ya kina ya kripto na neno la platformi ili kufahamu Web3.

steps.1: Glossari go dey for sidebar, go navigate.
steps.2: Look di word dem by ABC order or use search fo find di word weh yu want.
steps.3: Click one word make yu see e full meaning and explanation.
steps.4: Termz de kip kip konsep kripto, DeFi terminolojia, na feyshon DeHub.

tips.1: Resouw for pipo wey dey new to kripto and Web3.
tips.2: Glossari dey update regular wit new terms.

interacting-with-posts.title: How fo Interact wit Post Dem
interacting-with-posts.intro: Vot yong content, koment, tip, bukmark, shar, na translat.

steps.1: Voting post: upvote or downvote post wia arrow icon wey dey left side of post.
steps.2: Klik comment icon na open comment section, na leave reply.
steps.3: Klik na gem/tip ikon, sendim tip in DeHub tokens to post kreator.
steps.4: Klikim buk marka save post for later.
steps.5: Click share icon fo copy di post link or share am fo outside.
steps.6: Klik an na button ya translate (globe) wia post ya, na translate text to your language.
steps.7: Yu go use 'Translate Image' buton, taim get AI-translated version of text for image.
steps.8: Click any post fo open am fo full screen, one post alone.

tips.1: Tip dem di go straight fo creator e wallet fo DeHub tokens.
tips.2: Yu fit choose how much fo tip wit di quick-select button dem or put yu own amount.
tips.3: Bukumkum post dem dey accessible from Bookmarks paja for sidebar.

posting-allowance.intro: Fo post na free every day until yu reach allowance weh e di grow wit yu staking badge. Everybody di start wit ten text post and one gigabyte fo video, picture and audio every day. If yu pass any one, yu go pay di rest fo dat day fo DeHub tokens — only fo di part weh e pass.
posting-allowance.title: Yu Posting Allowance fo Every Day

steps.1: Post as normal. Wia allowance, no tins dey charge yu, no tins dey ask yu.
steps.2: Tek posts na media separate, so day yu dey upload video, all ten tek posts still free.
steps.3: Wen post go pass, app price am first, den check wallet whether you get money dey cover am before upload.
steps.4: Post go publish exactly like dat - publish no dey wait for payment.
steps.5: Yon dey approve wan transfer for dat post only, settle on wetin dey hold enough DeHub tokens for Base or BNB Chain.
steps.6: Di two pool dem di start again fo midnight UTC.

tips.1: Oversize dey dey calculate pro-rata: 200 MB pass yor allowance go cost 200 MB, no be whole gigabyte.
tips.2: Reposts, comments, reactions, tips na messages no dey cost naira, dem no dey touch allowance.
tips.3: Yu no go collect payment, post go remain up — amount go block yu next paid post until yu settle am. Tomorrow free allowance dey always belong to yu.
tips.4: A stakin badge ris raise free allowance na lower price of anytin wey pass am.

depin.title: DePin
depin.noFixedRate: No get fixed rate, minimum return, APY or forward estimate. Contribution record na only for accounting, no be promise of payment. Any future token settlement go happen for Base and remain subject to eligibility, network rule and applicable law.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Token wey you earn dis period
depin.threeJobsTitle: Won node, tree wey fit for work, three job.
depin.ctaBody: Origin backup, encrypted protected media and work wey dem don check go come first before any public node reward.
depin.ctaTitle: Launch only when e safe if something fail.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Small node wey di run for browser don di live for down. Bigger desktop node wey go di on all the time na plan for future, e never ready. To join no mean say you go surely collect reward.
depin.footerNote: DePin participation na contribution service, e no bi investment product. Availability, who fit join and rewards fit change.
depin.heroBlurb: Give your extra storage, bandwidth and compute make e help host, transcode and deliver DeHub content.
depin.heroCaption: DeHub di keep the main copy. Community nodes di add strong backup copies and local delivery power.
depin.heroImageAlt: Small edge-compute node wey connect to houses and creator studios
depin.nodesLeaveBody: No community machine di hold the only copy. Health checks, backup copies and origin backup di make playback di available.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: Network wey sabi say nodes go comot.
depin.privacyBody: Protected media di stay encrypted for community hardware. Dem di give playback keys separately to viewers wey get permission.
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts di keep pieces, dem no get access.
depin.runningCosts: To run node di use light, internet data and hardware life. Operators fit collect nothing, and their cost fit pass any reward.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin di first support the delivery path wey DeHub get already. Harder work go follow only after dem don prove say checking di work.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: We build am from the safest work go outside.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators di choose their storage, bandwidth and compute limit. DeHub di give only the work wey their machine fit carry safely.
depin.transcodeBody: Machines wey qualify di turn uploaded video to different quality versions. Dem di check every output before dem fit serve am.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Creator workstation for house wey di give extra GPU compute
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Dem di measure contribution with signed receipts, health checks and output checks. Storage alone no di bring reward.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Dem di check useful work. Rewards no di fixed.
depin.hostBody: Nodes di keep encrypted or content-addressed pieces for small local cache wey get limit. DeHub origin storage still bi the main source.
depin.deliverBody: Peers wey di near di share video pieces while the normal delivery path di ready as automatic backup.
depin.originBody: Main source copy wey no di go and backup delivery
depin.availableReplicasBody: Di serve checked pieces near where people need am
depin.offlineNodeBody: Dem remove am from routing until e connect again
depin.viewerBody: E di use peer when e di, origin when e need am
depin.protectedContentBody: Subscriber, private and pay-per-view pieces fit di stored as ciphertext. Node operators no di get access keys just because dem host data.
depin.publicContentBody: Encryption di stop people from just di look inside cached files, but people fit still watch public media for the public DeHub player. We no go talk anything different.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators di choose disk limit, bandwidth limit, work hours and the public content categories wey dem allow. Removal notice di clear the cache.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Checked bytes wey dem serve to real playback sessions.
depin.availabilityBody: Retrieval checks wey pass and service wey di reliable when dem give am work.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes must pass technical checks and quality checks wey dem sample.
depin.revenuePoolBody: If dem start am, reward budget go come from platform revenue after the epoch close.
depin.deliveryBody: Live and video delivery wey peers di help, with automatic backup.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Different quality versions so playback go di steady for any connection speed.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Storage wey get limit, bandwidth control and availability wey dem don check.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Claims wey revenue di fund only after operation and legal review.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Weti go happen when hosting node go offline?
depin.faqOfflineA: The coordinator go remove am from active routing. Another copy go serve the piece, or playback go fall back to DeHub origin storage while dem di arrange new copies.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Node operator fit see the content wey e di host?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Protected content di stored as encrypted pieces and the host no di get playback keys. Public content still di open for everybody to watch for DeHub, na so dem design am.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: How much node operator go collect?
depin.faqHowMuchA: No fixed rate or forecast di. Contribution wey dem don check fit get share from reward pool wey revenue di fund after epoch close. Rewards no di guaranteed, and light, bandwidth and hardware cost fit pass any reward.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Node software don di available now?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Small browser-based level di available today: sign in and opt in for this page, and your open tab go turn node while e still di open. Bigger desktop node wey go di on all the time na plan for future — e never exist.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: I need install anything for the browser node?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: No. E di run inside the tab with your browser local storage. If you close the tab your node go stop; no background service and no install.
depin.appSignInBlurb: Sign in make you see your node ledger: weti you don store, weti dem don check and weti you earn this period.
depin.appNodeBody: The node di run for browser tab, no bi for this app. Open DePin for web, sign in with this account and opt in. Your ledger go show for here.
